Enumerates physical DXGI adapters excluding software.
Creates two distinct D3D12 devices with explicit copy queues.
Allocates 256KiB shared buffer with SHARED_CROSS_ADAPTER heap flags.
Uses ALLOW_CROSS_ADAPTER resource flag and row-major layout.
Producer fills deterministic byte pattern and copies to shared buffer.
Consumer opens shared handle and copies to local readback buffer.
CPU verifies every byte matches the expected pattern.
Handles resource state transitions correctly between devices.
Checks all HRESULTs and uses bounded waits via events.
No graphics windows or shaders required.
